t: Amnesia as a Feature: Orchestrating NixOS with the Desert Kite AI Strategy
s: This article introduces the 'Desert Kite' strategy, leveraging AI's amnesiac state as a feature for robust NixOS orchestration. It details how precise context painting, 'phantom files' for historical state, and AI-assisted 'chisel strike' edits enable efficient collaboration with AI in managing complex system configurations.
sub: AI's amnesiac state as a powerful feature for 'starting from scratch'
The 'Desert Kite' strategy for orchestrating stable, modular NixOS configurations
Using 'phantom files' (e.g., old configs) to provide historical context to AI
The 'Chisel Strike' method for AI-assisted, precise configuration changes (e.g., re-enabling Mullvad VPN)
Comparison of 'Orchestrator' vs. 'Chat UI' for effective context painting
